title: Timed Writing Task 2: Opinion on Public Transport Priority
prompt: Some people believe that city governments should invest most of their transport budget in public transport systems, such as buses and trains, rather than in building new roads for private cars. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为限时写作练习（建议40分钟）。请先花约5分钟审题并列出立场与两至三个理由，再用约30分钟完成至少250词的完整议论文，最后留约5分钟检查。注意：题目要求你就“政府应把大部分交通预算投入公共交通而非新建私家车道路”这一观点表明同意或不同意的程度，并给出理由与相关例子；不要写成仅描述数据或罗列利弊的段落。本任务及所有情景、数据均为模拟练习材料，并非官方雅思试卷。
